# Changelog: Tessera v0.4.0 (1.21 – 26.3)

**Tessera** now runs on Fabric too, on Apple Silicon and Android GPUs, and compresses the block atlas, animated textures included, with every animation frame encoded only once.

---

## Key Features & Changes

* **Block Atlas Compressed, Animations Included**: The block atlas, the largest one, is compressed even though it holds water, lava, fire and other animated textures. Every animation frame is encoded once in the background when the game loads, so a frame change is just a small upload of blocks already encoded. Turn it off with "Compress Animated Atlases".
* **Works with Kerria**: With Kerria installed, the atlases with animated textures are left to Kerria and Tessera compresses all the others. Press F3 to see both.
* **Smaller Cut-out Textures**: Atlases without mipmaps whose textures are only fully see-through or fully solid (common in mods and resource packs) can now take half the video memory they did, with transparency kept exact. Tessera checks the result first: if an atlas would look worse, it keeps the larger format for it.
* **Fabric**: Tessera now runs on Fabric (with Fabric API) for every supported Minecraft version, with its settings in Mod Menu.
* **Apple Silicon and Android**: Uses ASTC, the format ARM GPUs take. macOS also takes the PC format for solid textures.
* **Faster Start-up**: An atlas that hasn't changed since the last launch is loaded from the disk cache in one go, and the cache takes less disk space.
* **Safer on Unusual Drivers**: Tessera checks that the graphics driver accepted each compressed atlas, and leaves it as vanilla if not.
* **Requirements**: Needs **Celeris** 0.3.1.1 or newer.

---

Most players should install Tessera from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/olpctCIW) or [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tessera) (launchers update it for you). The files below are the same release, for manual installs and developers.

# Changelog: Tessera v0.3.1 (1.21 – 26.3)

This update fixes a grey bar that appeared next to the crosshair.

---

## Key Features & Changes

* **Crosshair Fixed**: The crosshair no longer shows a grey bar beside it. Tessera now leaves the small interface texture atlas alone, so every menu, hotbar and HUD sprite is drawn exactly as in vanilla. The saving lost is about a megabyte of video memory.
* **Same On Every Version**: The fix applies to every supported Minecraft version, 1.21 – 1.21.11 and 26.1 – 26.3.

# Changelog: Tessera v0.3.0 (1.21 – 26.3)

**Tessera** now works on every Minecraft version from 1.21 to 26.3, not just 1.21.1. This update also fixes fire, lanterns and other animated textures with see-through parts, which looked noticeably worse than the rest of the game.

---

## Key Features & Changes

* **Many More Minecraft Versions**: Works on Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.11 and 26.1 – 26.3, with NeoForge. Pick the Tessera file for your Minecraft version (the Modrinth and CurseForge apps do this for you). Every one of these versions passed an automatic test in the game, animated textures included.
* **Sharper Animated Textures**: Fire, lanterns, campfires, sculk and other animated textures with see-through parts now look as sharp as everything else.
* **See Your Savings with F3**: Press F3 to see how much video memory Tessera saves. On 1.21 – 1.21.4, hold F3 and press 4 for a detailed list. On 1.21.10 and newer, turn the detailed list on in the game's debug options; Tessera's own "Show Extended Atlas Breakdown" setting only works on 1.21 – 1.21.4. On 1.21.5 – 1.21.9, Tessera doesn't show up on the F3 screen, but it still saves just as much video memory.
* **Join Any Server**: Tessera no longer stops you from joining servers that don't have Celeris. Before, the server turned you away.
* **Requirements**: Now needs **Celeris** 0.2.1 or newer. Windows and Linux only: macOS doesn't support the texture format Tessera needs.

---
